defect.statement: The control mutated only the OSSL_FUNC_* match-arm label in src/provider/child.rs. Commit c74d59e72 moved the authoritative id into the argument of function_for::<ChildFreeFn>(p, OSSL_FUNC_PROVIDER_FREE), and _core_dispatch_writer reads the first OSSL_FUNC_* token at or before the store line, which after the refactor is the argument on line 538. Renaming the arm therefore no longer produced a wrong-id store, so the control could not refuse and the self-test failed.
defect.why_the_failure_was_correct: The self-test failing is the control doing its job: it detected that the mutation no longer exercised the invariant. A control that had silently kept passing would have been the worse outcome.
